Name: (CP) Claude's Dwarf Portraits- With Emotions
Author: HeadInTheCloudsMods
Description:
[size=3]Update 1.2: Hey all! After a [i][b]lot[/b][/i] of work, I've successfully added configs, and like.. 10 more expressions? I'm losing track-
Wanna thank all my friends on the SDV discord server, especially all the people in my thread, you're all a major source of encouragement for me, and y'all are just the sweetest <3 could never have released this without your support :)


Fairly simple Dwarf portrait replacer, just plop it into your mod folder and voila, dwarf portraits! Note that the expressions won’t naturally show up in vanilla, you’d have to have a mod that includes expressions in its dialog lines and then it’ll show up. Pls lmk if you encounter any issues, and enjoy!
[/size]

[b][size=3]Lil backstory, info and credits:
[/size][/b]Hey everyone! This is my first ever mod, so please lmk if you encounter any issues with it!
I’m currently working on a huge Krobus and Dwarf expansion bc [i]they’re so cute together[/i], and I wanted to give Dwarf more emotions for it, and thus, this mod was born! I used [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LavenderSkelly/mods]LavenderSkelly[/url]'s fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14916]Dwarf Portrait Replacement [/url]as a base for these since I can’t draw without a base lol, I highly recommend you check out their stuff! As the base mod is compatible with The Last Smoluanu by Lemurkat, this mod is as well. [b]Just keep in mind that this mod has much more exaggerated facial expressions, so a few dialog lines might have weird expressions.[/b] But do not fear- eventually ([s]in like idk a decade[/s]) when I release my Krobus and Dwarf mod, it’ll include an edit to TLS that includes making the facial expressions more consistent with my mod (said edit will be posted on Lemurkat’s side).

Also, huge thanks to the whole modding side of the SDV discord server, y’all are amazing and so helpful :))
Special thanks to: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato/mods]Mushymato[/url]﻿ for helping with the actual implementation, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/zombifier/mods]zombifier[/url] for keeping me from hours of debugging related to spotting an error in my code that would have accidentally deleted Dwarf's entire character bc I put the wrong field, everyone who gave me feedback on my pixel art, and a few other aspiring mod authors who don’t have pages to credit yet :)
